items.title: Approve the Minutes of December 10, 2024 Meeting
Allocate $3,300,000 and Appropriate $350,000 in Prop L Funds, with Conditions, Allocate $672,000 in Prop AA Funds, and Allocate $4,185,000 in Traffic Congestion Mitigation Tax

Authorize the Executive Director to Execute a Memorandum of Understanding with the TJPA, the Metropolitan Transportation Commission, the Peninsula Corridor Joint Powers Board, the California High-Speed Rail Authority
Award a Construction Contract to the Lowest Responsible and Responsive Bidder, Thompson Builders Corporation, in an Amount Not to Exceed $8,965,637, with Conditions
Accept the Audit Report for the Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2024
